description: This file defines interfaces, proxy, and stub classes for IUnknown in a COM-like RPC framework, including reference counting, interface querying, and message handling.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for stub implementations handling interface conversion and message handling.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class for specific interface stub with method handlers.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing communication, reference counting, and interface querying for remote objects.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template class for proxy interface, providing application-level access and management.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of method handlers or stub length.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data to a specific interface pointer.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming messages based on index.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a reference to the interface, possibly creating a proxy.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and possibly destroys the proxy.

methods.name: LinkId
methods.description: Returns the link ID of the channel.

methods.name: Interface
methods.description: Gets interface pointer for given implementation and ID.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates a message for a specific method.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a message over IPC channel.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes a call, adding or releasing cached implementations.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for specific interface by ID.
